main_text.head: DE IOANNA PAPISSA FABVLA AB ALLATIO PROFLIGATA Nonnullorum Clarorum Virorum ELOGIA.
main_text.p: ANTONIVS CARACCIOLVS Cler. Regul. & in Dioecesi Neapolitana Librorum Censor.

p.i: OPusculum hoc eruditissimi Viri, & Graecis literis excultissimi Leonis Allatij adversus Ioannam Papissam τῷ μυθώδῃ[?], si paginas Lector numeres, paruum profecto est; si pondera expendas argumentorum, re vera magnum, adeoque validum, ut sicut de Tertulliano Lirinensis ait, quot in eo sensus, tot sint victoriae. Complures quidem ad idem monstrum interimendum suas quisque ingenij, stylique vires certatim contulerunt, sed pace illorum dixerim, Allatius a Gracis quibusdam Scriptoribus, quos hactenus nemo hominum tam diligenter excussit, ea profert iacula rationum, ut, nisi velint se ipsos excaecare haeretici, cogendi sint, cum legent, fabellam abijcere

page.notes: The Greek phrase "τῷ μυθώδῃ" is hard to read at the scan resolution; the accents and final letter are uncertain. The Greek word "μυθώδη" is marked [?]. The large initial "O" is joined to "Pusculum" as "OPusculum". The text on the right edge is the neighbouring page and show-through and is not transcribed. The catchword "quam" stands alone at the foot of the right column.
